No UPS price is published. Stand-in: USPS Ground Advantage retail, 9 lb, Zone 8, $37.10 (Notice 123, effective 2026-10-04). 9 lb guesses the boxed weight: 41 ribbon cables at 22 g each (read on the 3890 page) are 0.9 kg; 20 Raspberry Pi 15 W supplies have no published weight (taken as about 100 g each); the small parts and box add about 1 kg. Get a cart estimate before ordering.
